data.summary: Review of prv-09-prov-diff-and-commit-tools.md implementation in plugin/provenance-tools/. The changes add three new tools (prov_diff_expand, prov_commit_materialize, prov_commit_expand) for git diff and commit introspection. While the implementation demonstrates strong patterns in schema design, error handling, and bounded limiting, there are significant complexity concerns due to file size violations and interleaved concerns that impact maintainability.

findings.title: File exceeds 1750 lines - violates commons-grade standards
findings.description: The expand/index.ts file is 1,754 lines, far exceeding the 300-line guideline for commons-grade readability. This severely impacts local reasoning and makes the code difficult to navigate, review, and maintain.
findings.evidence: File size: 1754 lines. Contains: 3 tool definitions, 15+ schema definitions, diff parsing logic, evidence building, response construction, and 25+ helper functions.
findings.recommendation: Split into focused modules: diff-parser.ts (diff parsing logic), evidence-builder.ts (evidence linking), response-builders.ts (success/failure builders), and tool-definitions.ts (tool schemas and execute functions). Target: 5 files, each <300 lines.

findings.title: Diff parsing complected with business logic
findings.description: The parseUnifiedDiff function (123 lines) interleaves low-level parsing mechanics with business logic for status inference. It uses mutable state (MutableDiffSection) and mixes parsing, validation, and transformation in a single large function.
findings.evidence: parseUnifiedDiff uses a mutable 'current' section with 12+ mutation sites, performs regex matching, status inference, and accumulation all in one loop.
findings.recommendation: Extract diff parsing to a pure module: (1) parse raw diff into intermediate AST, (2) validate AST, (3) transform to domain types. Make MutableDiffSection immutable or hide mutations behind a builder interface.

findings.title: resolveFileAnchorDiff mixes orchestration, data fetching, and transformation
findings.description: This 110-line function handles: (1) parallel state resolution, (2) comparison entry mapping, (3) diff reading, (4) section matching, (5) evidence building, and (6) result assembly. Understanding it requires tracking 6+ variables across 5 distinct phases.
findings.evidence: Function has 8 parameters, creates 4 intermediate arrays, performs 3 Promise.all calls, and mixes async I/O with synchronous data transformations.
findings.recommendation: Decompose into pipeline stages: buildComparisonContext(), fetchDiffs(), matchSections(), assembleResult(). Each stage should be a pure function with explicit inputs/outputs.

findings.title: Explicit mutable state in diff parsing
findings.description: The MutableDiffSection type and parseUnifiedDiff implementation use explicit mutation for accumulating parsing state. While contained, this pattern makes the code harder to reason about and test.
findings.evidence: MutableDiffSection has mutable fields (oldPath, newPath, explicitStatus, additions, deletions, hunks, lines). The flush() closure captures and mutates 'current'.
findings.recommendation: Refactor to immutable accumulation: use reduce() with an immutable accumulator, or a state machine with explicit state transitions. Consider using a parser combinator library for complex parsing.

findings.title: Schema definitions interleaved with implementation
findings.description: 15+ Zod schema definitions (130+ lines) are located at the top of expand/index.ts, mixed with type aliases and constants. This makes it hard to find the contract definitions and separates them from related runtime code.
findings.evidence: PatchHunkSchema, PatchTextSchema, PatchSummarySchema, DiffChangeSummarySchema, etc. defined lines 86-217, while related builder functions (buildPatchSummary, toDiffChangeSummary) appear 500+ lines later.
findings.recommendation: Move all schemas to expand/schemas.ts. Co-locate schema with its builder functions and TypeScript types. Follow the contracts.ts pattern used elsewhere.

findings.title: Warning aggregation logic duplicated
findings.description: Confidence/ambiguity calculation and warning deduplication appear in multiple places with slight variations. This creates maintenance risk when changing confidence logic.
findings.evidence: getLowestConfidence/getHighestAmbiguity defined at lines 394-416, used in tool execution. Similar logic appears in collectDiffWarnings (876-937) and materializeCommit.
findings.recommendation: Extract provenance aggregation utilities to a shared module: aggregateConfidence(), aggregateAmbiguity(), collectWarnings(). Make them pure functions with clear contracts.

findings.title: Tool execute functions are large and deeply nested
findings.description: Each tool's execute function is 100-130 lines with 3-4 levels of nesting (try/catch, if/else, loops). This makes the control flow hard to follow and test.
findings.evidence: prov_diff_expand execute: 133 lines, 4 nesting levels. prov_commit_expand execute: 132 lines, includes parallel Promise.all and sequential await.
findings.recommendation: Apply the 'extract till you drop' pattern: (1) Extract validation to validateInput(), (2) Extract core logic to execute*Core(), (3) Extract error handling to handle*Error(), (4) Keep execute as orchestration only.

findings.title: Tests are comprehensive but have some duplication
findings.description: The test file is well-structured with good coverage, but test setup patterns are repeated across tests. Each test recreates similar directory structures and mock files.
findings.evidence: Lines 1181-1382 and 1384-1467 show similar setup patterns for diff expand tests. The makeShellStub pattern is duplicated with slight variations.
findings.recommendation: Extract common test fixtures and helpers to reduce duplication. Create a test factory for common scenarios (clean repo, dirty repo, renamed file chain).

findings.title: Magic constant without context
findings.description: EMPTY_TREE_HASH is defined as a bare string constant without explanation of its significance.
findings.evidence: EMPTY_TREE_HASH = '4b825dc642cb6eb9a060e54bf8d69288fbee4904' - this is the git empty tree hash, but not documented.
findings.recommendation: Add JSDoc comment explaining this is git's empty tree SHA for root commits.

findings.title: Excellent bounded limiting pattern throughout
findings.description: The implementation consistently applies bounded limiting (item count, byte count) across all tools. This prevents unbounded memory usage and provides clear truncation signals to consumers.
findings.evidence: applyBoundedLimit() and applyByteBudget() used in: buildLinkedEvidence, buildPatchSummary, materializeCommit, resolveFileAnchorDiff. Hints clearly communicate truncation to users.
findings.recommendation: Document this pattern as a standard for future provenance tools. The separation of concerns between item limits and byte budgets is well-designed.

positive_highlights: Strong schema-first design using Zod with discriminated unions for success/failure paths
Consistent structured logging throughout all tools with appropriate log levels
Excellent error handling with typed errors, retryable flags, and user-friendly messages
Comprehensive test coverage (1468 lines of tests) with realistic scenarios
Clean bounded limiting pattern preventing unbounded memory usage
Good separation between pure functions (buildPatchSummary, toDiffChangeSummary) and effectful code
The tool factory pattern (createExpandTools) enables clean dependency injection
Evidence linking shows good understanding of domain relationships

recommendations.action: Split expand/index.ts (1754 lines) into 5 focused modules: expand/diff-parser.ts, expand/evidence-builder.ts, expand/response-builders.ts, expand/schemas.ts, and expand/tools.ts. Target each file <300 lines.
Refactor parseUnifiedDiff to use immutable accumulation instead of MutableDiffSection. Extract to expand/diff-parser.ts as a pure function.
Decompose resolveFileAnchorDiff into pipeline stages with explicit inputs/outputs. Separate I/O from transformation logic.
Extract schema definitions to expand/schemas.ts and co-locate with related builder functions.
Create shared provenance utilities module for confidence/ambiguity aggregation to eliminate duplication.
Refactor tool execute functions using 'extract till you drop' - extract validation, core logic, and error handling into separate functions.
Add JSDoc to EMPTY_TREE_HASH explaining it's git's empty tree SHA.
